definitions.short: Asher , a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H836. Asher אָשֵׁר proper name, masculine Asher ( happy one, Felix , compare Phoenician אשרשלח , which however may contain (god) Asshur or Osiris, compare Bae Rel 161 ). 1 son of Jacob and Zilpah Gen 30:13 ; 35:26 ; 46:17 ; Exod 1:4 ; Num 26:46 ; 1Chr 2:2 . 2 the tribe Gen 49:20 ; Num 1:13 ; Deut 27:13 ; 33:24 (twice in verse); Josh 17:10-11 , 19:34 ; Judg 1:31 ; 5:17 ; 6:36 ; 7:23 ; 1Kin 4:16 ; 1Chr 12:36 ; 2Chr 30:11 ; Ezek 48:2-3 , 34 ; אָשֵׁר בְּנֵי Num 1:40 ; 2:27 ; 7:72 ; 10:26 ; 26:44 , 47 ; 34:27 ; Josh 19:24 , 31 ; 1Chr 7:30 , 40 ; אָשֵׁר מַטֵּה Num 1:41 ; 2:27 ; 13:13 ; Josh 21:6 , 30 ; 1Chr 6:47 ; 6:59 . 3. proper name, of a location city east of Shechem Josh 17:7 .
